dossier.scp_unleashed.327.title: The Shoal That Sings
dossier.scp_unleashed.327.caption: SCP-327 photographed at dusk, head and shoulders above still water.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-327 instances are to be held in a flooded tank no less than %rfour%r metres deep, under a sealed lid, with a dry observation gallery alongside. Instances do not survive long out of water and are not to be moved from the tank without approval.

No member of staff is to attend the gallery alone, and no one is to approach the waterline while an instance is at the surface. Staff assigned to the tank are to complete %rProcedure 327-Q%r before each shift.
**Any increase in the number of instances is to be reported at once.**

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-327 is a group of aquatic humanoids, mermaid-like in outline. Each has a gaunt upper body with long, thin arms and webbed fingers, joined at the hip to a long tapering tail that ends in a broad, pale fin. The skin is a speckled grey-green. Instances have no eyes. Their hair is long, dark and stringy.

An adult measures roughly three metres from head to fin. Instances are strong and graceful swimmers. They tolerate open air poorly, but have been seen hauling themselves onto a shore for short periods.

Instances are drawn to people. When one has settled close to a person, it rises at the surface or on the shore and sings. The song is slow and wordless, and most who hear it call it beautiful. Listeners who stay within earshot tend to walk toward the water.
Any instance that reaches a listener takes hold of them and dives.

page.title: Addendum 327-1: Recovery
page.text: The first three instances were found in a flooded quarry with no inflow, a week after it was last surveyed and found empty. Every opened copy of this file has since been followed by a sighting in the nearest open water.

page.title: Addendum 327-2: Interview
text: Researcher %rVale%r, recovered from the shallows: "I never heard it start. I just noticed my boots were wet, and that I did not want to stop."
Researcher %rVale%r has requested a transfer to a site without open water.

page.title: Addendum 327-3: Note
page.text: Smaller instances have been observed. They are hairless at first and keep close to the adults. %rThe circumstances of their appearance are restricted.%r
